notes.title: Light Unseen Release
notes.notes:
At long last Light Unseen has been released as of today!
Enjoy and review as you fit
Enough sales will motivate me to update the game to complete the story
[spoiler]
The story will continue as Sion reaches the middle layer
Encounters other marked ones
Learn the history of the carions
Meet the king and the bishop and at last see the light that is yet to be seen
[/spoiler]
